name: Disorient
body:
Design revelation (thought) [mind-affecting]; Level 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature of 5 HD or less
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This script clouds the mind of a single creature with 5 or fewer Hit Dice, dazing it for 1 round so that it takes no actions. Creatures of 6 or more HD are not affected.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, increase the maximum HD of creature that can be affected by 5 and increase the DC by +1.
